Both disclosures define Leverage Exposure. gs_2024_7_D172 defines it as average adjusted total assets and off-balance sheet exposures. gs_2025_7_D194 (sentence gs_2025_7_P290_S005) provides the matching definition.

comparisons.peer_topic: TLAC and Long-Term Debt Calculation Method
comparisons.peer_summary: The Standardized approach is used to calculate TLAC and long-term debt ratios as it yields the higher Risk-Weighted Assets, applied for both 2024 and 2023.
comparisons.comparison: Both Goldman Sachs (GS) and Bank of America (BAC) disclose that they use the Standardized approach to calculate Risk-Weighted Assets (RWA) for determining TLAC and external long-term debt ratios because it yields the higher RWA. Both companies applied this same methodology for both December 2024 and December 2023.

sentences.text: • In accordance with the TLAC rules, the higher of Standardized or Advanced RWAs are used in the calculation of TLAC and external long-term debt ratios and applicable requirements. RWAs represent Standardized RWAs as of both December 2024 and December 2023.
(4)The approach that yields the higher RWA is used to calculate TLAC and long-term debt ratios, which was the Standardized approach as of December 31, 2024 and 2023.
